summary: Oxford Square Capital Corp. filed an 8-K announcing an amendment to its existing equity distribution agreement with sales agents Lucid Capital Markets and Ladenburg Thalmann. The amendment allows continued at-the-market sales of common stock under its effective shelf registration statement. No specific terms, price, or premium are disclosed, as this is a routine shelf takedown mechanism. The filing includes a legal opinion from Dechert LLP. This is an ordinary capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. No event-driven catalyst, activist campaign, or structural change is present.
